rules: One destructive endpoint consumes that specimen identity; later reuse is rejected.
Different conditions and camera frames do not create independent specimens.
Repeated-cycle histories retain the same identity and increasing cycle indices.
Replacement is a new identity linked to a failed attempt; failure is never erased.
Assemblies retain all component IDs and versions; membership changes create a new assembly version.
Service custody transfer, safe release and measured state changes need distinct trusted receipts.
